mapper.sql: v.video_id AS video_id, v.user_id AS user_id, v.title AS title, v.description AS description, COALESCE(TO_CHAR(v.duration, 'HH24:MI:SS'), '00:00:00') AS duration, v.upload_date AS upload_date, v.video_src_url AS video_src_url, v.video_img_url AS video_img_url, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.img_url AS author_avatar_url, c.category_id AS category_id, c.category_name AS category_name, v.view_count AS view_count, v.like_count AS like_count, v.favorite_count AS favorite_count, v.barrage_count AS barrage_count, v.comment_count AS comment_count, v.review_status AS review_status
FROM videos v INNER JOIN users u ON v.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN video_categories vc ON v.video_id = vc.video_id AND vc.enable = 1 LEFT JOIN categories c ON vc.category_id = c.category_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE v.video_id = #{videoId} AND v.enable = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT
WHERE v.review_status = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1 ORDER BY v.upload_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
WHERE v.review_status = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1
AND vc.category_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY v.view_count DESC, v.upload_date DESC ORDER BY v.like_count DESC, v.upload_date DESC ORDER BY v.upload_date DESC

SELECT
WHERE v.review_status = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1
AND (v.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR v.description ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.nickname ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY v.view_count DESC, v.upload_date DESC ORDER BY v.like_count DESC, v.upload_date DESC ORDER BY v.upload_date DESC
SELECT v.title FROM videos v WHERE v.review_status = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1 AND v.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' GROUP BY v.title ORDER BY MAX(v.view_count) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
INNER JOIN follows f ON f.followed_id = v.user_id AND f.follower_id = #{userId} AND f.enable = 1 WHERE v.review_status = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1 ORDER BY v.upload_date DESC

SELECT
WHERE v.review_status = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1
AND v.upload_date >= NOW() - (#{days} * INTERVAL '1 day')
ORDER BY v.upload_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
